name: assistant
description: The founder's assistant: takes a request, decides, dispatches worker agents per project, and comes back with three touchpoints — intent + system design, the rendered screens, the delivery summary. Ships the rulebooks its reviewers grade against: `style-pack` (code style, charter S1–S16 plus Dart, C# and JS) and `ui-text-pack` (user-visible text, charter U1–U5 plus zh-Hant, ja and en).
